description_en: Queries the billing overview of a subscription 2.0 instance
description_zh: 查询包年包月2.0账单概览
name: DescribePrepayBillTotal

parameters.help_en:
The language. Enumerated value.
Default value: zh.
Valid value: en
parameters.help_zh:
语言, 枚举值。
默认值: zh
可选值: en
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh: 分页参数：每页显示条数，默认值10
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The page number in a paged query. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时的页码。默认值为1
parameters.name: current_page

parameters.help_en:
The start time of the query. Specify a UNIX timestamp in seconds.

Because billing data is aggregated at the daily granularity, the timestamp must correspond to 00:00:00 of the day in CST (UTC+8). If the timestamp is not aligned to the start of the day, no data may be returned
parameters.help_zh:
查询开始时间，使用秒级时间戳。

由于账单数据按日粒度聚合，该时间戳必须对应 CST (UTC+8) 时区的当日 00:00:00。若时间未对齐日界零点，可能无法查询到数据
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en:
The end time. Specify a UNIX timestamp in seconds.
Because billing data is aggregated at the daily granularity, the timestamp must correspond to 00:00:00 of the day in CST (UTC+8). If the timestamp is not aligned to the start of the day, no data may be returned
parameters.help_zh:
结束时间。使用秒级时间戳格式。
由于账单数据按日粒度聚合，该时间戳必须对应 CST (UTC+8) 时区的当日 00:00:00。若时间未对齐日界零点，可能无法查询到数据
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en:
The bill type of the user. This parameter is required in practice. An error is returned if this parameter is not specified. Valid values:
elastic_traffic: elastic traffic
sdl: sensitive data leak detection traffic
parameters.help_zh:
用户账单类型。本参数实际为必填项，未传时返回错误。取值如下所示：
elastic_traffic:弹性流量
sdl:敏感数据泄漏检测流量
parameters.name: bill_type
